rows.label: tlk70000049_02_msg001
rows.name:
Adel-sama, I hardly need say it again,
but please don't push yourself too
far.

rows.label: tlk70000049_02_msg002
rows.name:
Your compassion is a wonderful virtue,
but you go out of your way to take on
danger...

rows.label: tlk70000049_02_msg003
rows.name:
Please refrain from caring for others
to the point of putting yourself in
danger.

rows.label: tlk70000049_02_msg004
rows.name:
Adel-sama is the king's only heir. I
know you dislike hearing that, but...

rows.label: tlk70000049_02_msg005
rows.name:
Your life carries more weight than
others. You must not forget that.
